method: Actual independent 2D panel solver, 320 total panels, incompressible/inviscid. Standard application closed-TE NACA0012, not the thickness-extended TMR CFD geometry.
interpretation: Validation against experiment exposes model-form differences. No Reynolds-number boundary layer, roughness, tunnel-wall or Mach correction applied. No force-fit or pressure correction.

pressure.conditions: Gregory & O’Reilly R&M3726; Re2.88e6; digitized from photocopy by NASA TMR; upper surface only; approximate points retained at native locations.
